command_line: [ -f /usr/local/ssl/cacert.pem ] && export SSL_CERT_FILE="/usr/local/ssl/cacert.pem";  datasets download gene symbol 'DUOXA1' 'TERB2' 'SORD' 'SLC28A2' 'C15orf48' 'BEND5' 'SQOR' 'SHF'  --taxon 'human'    --include protein,rna --no-progressbar  && dataformat tsv gene --package ncbi_dataset.zip --fields symbol,gene-id,ensembl-geneids,omim-ids,annotation-genomic-range-seq-name,genomic-region-gene-range-range-start,genomic-region-gene-range-range-stop,description --force > gene_data_report.tsv   && unzip ncbi_dataset.zip
